title: Welcome to the Real World: How You Live in Your Own Simulation of Reality — and How We Can Still Share a World. A Theory of Persistence, Emergence, Learning, and Correctable Intelligence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v22.4 keeps the core of v22.3: CORE.md follows one model of learning, read as a network, in eight steps, and formalization/ebe-core/EbECore.lean audits 91 machine-checked results. CORE.md now says that the theory describes a process, not a substrate. Nine new core-Lean modules outside the core cover the value of curiosity, exit options, identity as a process, linked revision, two existence lemmas, power in two speeds, coupling between scales, what follows from being a model of a reality larger than oneself, and foresight. A new text for AI readers, What an AI is, and what follows, keeps apart what an AI system is, what follows from that, what follows given a stated aim, and what is proposed as a value. Small tests with readers from several AI model families, including two documents that the readers improved pass by pass until they settled, found that readers of other families accepted the facts and took apart several derivations; one step, keeping one's sources going, needs one value, stated openly. New research lines cover curiosity, identity, an existence conjecture and the biological process. DIALOGUE.md records how the author and an AI assistant build the model together, now in 26 entries. The release title uses ‘simulation of reality’ to mean the internal model through which a system experiences and acts in the world, not a claim that reality itself is simulated. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open.
